title: Jaanbaaz
desc: Bikram, a gangster, works in a coal mafia. Soon, he falls in love with a mysterious woman, whose true identity he is unaware of.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Kaali Aamar Maa
desc: Lakshmi's birth causes her mother's passing, yet Goddess Kali assumes a maternal role.

title: Satya Mithya
desc: Worried to see his daughter Rita in low spirits, Mr Chowdhury decides to take her to Dhaka. There, he hires Raju, a responsible young man, whom Rita falls in love with.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

title: Kamalar Banabas
desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

title: Takkar
desc: Chaitali, a rich girl, marries Arun against her family's wishes. Soon, their relationship turns sour and the bone of contention between the couple is the man's nephew.
